description: This file is the main entry point for an Android Cuttlefish frontend operator service, setting up HTTP/S servers, proxy configurations, and device control endpoints.

methods.name: startHttpServer
methods.description: Starts an HTTP server listening on specified address and port.

methods.name: startHttpsServer
methods.description: Starts an HTTPS server with TLS certificates at specified address and port.

methods.name: maybeIntercept
methods.description: Determines whether a device file request should be intercepted and served from the signaling server.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Runs multiple startup functions concurrently and waits for all to complete.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point initializing server configuration, proxies, and endpoints, then starting the servers.
